newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to fund Albania force from existing resource.
newsitem.headline: Italy to fund Albania force from existing resource.

text.p: The Italian cabinet approved a decree on Thursday to finance Italy's involvement in a multinational force in Albania without raising extra revenue, sources at the prime minister's office said.
The decree envisages financing for the mission, which is being led by Italy, of a total 120 billion lire.

The sources said half the money would come from an existing income tax fund amounting to 0.8 percent of an individual's payment. The fund is primarily used as a contribution to the Roman Catholic Church.

The rest would come from the budgets of ministries involved in the Albania mission, the sources said. Italy is leading the force of some 6,000 troops, about 2,500 of them Italian. It is expected to stay in Albania for up to six months.
